# algebra.concepts: IDifference

**Status:** Supported (tier `foundation`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> A position-like type whose difference is a separate delta type: subtracting two
> points yields a vector; adding a vector to a point yields a point.
> See affine space (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Affine\_space).
>
> TDelta is bound to IAdditive and Scalable: the deltas are the group acting on
> the positions, so they must at least add, negate, and scale. Every delta in
> this vocabulary already satisfies both (Vector2D/3D/N via INumerical, Duration
> via IQuantity), and the bound is what lets the rest of the affine surface —
> Subtract in both spellings, Lerp, and the reversed Add — be derived once in
> algebra.library.plato instead of hand-written per implementor.
>
> Only two members are primitive. Add and Between are exactly the torsor action
> and its inverse; everything else in the affine API follows from them.

## Signature

```plato
interface IDifference<TDelta>
    where TDelta: IAdditive, TDelta: IScalable
```

```plato

// A position-like type whose difference is a separate delta type: subtracting two
// points yields a vector; adding a vector to a point yields a point.
// See affine space (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Affine_space).
//
// TDelta is bound to IAdditive and Scalable: the deltas are the group acting on
// the positions, so they must at least add, negate, and scale. Every delta in
// this vocabulary already satisfies both (Vector2D/3D/N via INumerical, Duration
// via IQuantity), and the bound is what lets the rest of the affine surface —
// Subtract in both spellings, Lerp, and the reversed Add — be derived once in
// algebra.library.plato instead of hand-written per implementor.
//
// Only two members are primitive. Add and Between are exactly the torsor action
// and its inverse; everything else in the affine API follows from them.
interface IDifference<TDelta>
    where TDelta: IAdditive, TDelta: IScalable
{
    Add(x: Self, delta: TDelta): Self;
    // The displacement FROM a TO b, i.e. b - a. Direction convention: Between and
    // Add are inverse, so a.Add(a.Between(b)) == b. Every implementor and every
    // caller relies on this orientation (Point2D/Point3D honor it in
    // transforms.library.plato; the ScaleAbout/RotateAbout helpers in
    // intervals-transforms-deformable.library.plato assume it).
    Between(a: Self, b: Self): TDelta;
}
```
